capabilities: Publish the active note to BrewPage
Publish selected text as a new page
Update the same page when a note is republished
Copy the returned link to the clipboard
Strip frontmatter, comments, embeds and wikilinks before sending
extras: Publishing is free and needs no account; pages expire after the BrewPage default retention period unless extended on brewpage.app. The owner token is saved in the plugin's data.json and should be treated like a password. Images and attachments are not uploaded.
problem: Notes live as local Markdown files, so there is no built-in way to hand someone a single note as a web page with a link.

relations.evidence: brewpage.app: the hosting service; API guide; OpenAPI docs

summary: Publisher that sends the current note or selected text to BrewPage as a styled web page and copies the shareable link.
